notes: Reviewed creator profile for OpenAI. Seeds are canonical OpenAI-owned URLs; the tool describes and never fetches them.

terminology.family: OpenAI groups models into families such as the GPT series (GPT-4, GPT-4o) and the o-series reasoning models (o1, o3).
terminology.release: A specific, usually dated model version exposed through the API, e.g. gpt-4o-2024-08-06. The dateless name (gpt-4o) is an alias that points at the current dated snapshot.
terminology.product: ChatGPT is a product built on these models and is a separate entity from any individual model release.
terminology.serving: Models are served through the OpenAI API (platform.openai.com) and, separately, through Microsoft Azure OpenAI.

naming_rules.subject: family
naming_rules.rule: Use OpenAI's own family label (GPT series, o-series). Do not merge the GPT and o-series families.
naming_rules.example: GPT-4o belongs to the GPT family; o3 belongs to the o-series.

naming_rules.subject: release
naming_rules.rule: Prefer the dated snapshot as the canonical release name; record the dateless name as an API alias.

naming_rules.subject: api-alias
naming_rules.rule: API model identifiers are lowercase, hyphenated strings taken verbatim from the API reference.

source_catalog.trust_notes: OpenAI's official announcement and research feed, linked from the openai.com global navigation.
source_catalog.verification: Canonical announcement index reachable from the openai.com home navigation.

source_catalog.trust_notes: The API model reference; authoritative for exposed model identifiers and context-window limits.
source_catalog.verification: Developer platform documentation under the openai.com-owned platform.openai.com host.

notes: Extract API identifiers only from the API reference, never inferred from prose.
Keep ChatGPT (product) claims separate from GPT/o-series model releases.
A dateless model name is an apiAliases entry, not a release's canonicalName.

ambiguities.note: Reasoning models (o1, o3) and GPT models are marketed together but are distinct families.
ambiguities.guidance: Attribute each release to the family OpenAI names for it; do not invent a combined family.

ambiguities.note: "ChatGPT" is often used loosely to mean the underlying model.
ambiguities.guidance: Record ChatGPT as a product; attribute capabilities to the specific model release only when the source does.

ambiguities.note: gpt-4o may point at different dated snapshots over time.
ambiguities.guidance: Treat the dated snapshot as the release; leave the alias to snapshot mapping to a human if the source is silent.
